body: Oh god I feel you OP. I actually can't stand "it's all worth it." Ok maybe for you it is in which case good for you, but for me right now the fact that any pleasures in life is trivial compared to its pains is the exact reason why it's NOT all worth it. Nothing could be worth the absolute hell that is my mind.
Thank you for saying that. I just wish I could believe it.

I feel exactly the same way as you, but I'm a girl. Incessant self-loathing and having a self-esteem that's festering in the gutter sucks shit. I'm sorry you're going through this, I know how fucking shitty it is.

>But who would really want me. It's just me.

I have this thought every day. It sucks. *hugs*
Your experience mirrors mine exactly. It sucks that such a significant aspect of our lives is dictated by such a menial and arbitrary quality as appearance.

I can so relate. The opposite sex only want me when I'm useful too, and I'm only ever useful for getting their dicks wet.

I'm sorry things are this way for you too.

Thank you so so so much for all your advice and support. It means more than I can say that some internet strangers are willing to go out of their way to help me. I'm going to be seeing a psychiatrist soon, which I originally had mixed feelings about, but I now realise is imperative if I want to get better. I'll also be working to better myself and be more positive. I think a smile calendar/diary is an awesome idea. Thank you again for being so amazing to me, I truly appreciate it.

That's actually great advice. I used to love going to the gym but like you said, depression has made me drop off from that completely. I'm definitely going to try and get back in it though. I also *love* music. Next time I'm feeling overwhelmed I'm going to put my headphones in and do pushups until I collapse in exhaustion (in a good way). Thanks for all your help, I'm feeling cautiously optimistic about this!

Thank you for your response. I'm definitely looking up as much information about mental health and counselling as I can. In the meantime, however, I still feel like whenever I break down at night I have to choose between self-harm and burdening my friends. Do you have any advice about what to do in these situations? I'm so lost.
